name: @clarity/authorization-service
description: Authorization-readiness command service (preparation phase only). Records whether payer authorization is required per coverage — derived from recorded benefit quotes, never asserted by the caller — tracks preparation status through the existing authorization state machine, and derives a per-coverage readiness view with named gaps and deliberately no aggregate score. No payer submission, no integrations; SUBMITTED and later statuses are out of scope until the submission phase (which must gate on assertHumanSubmitter). No Prisma outside the approved gateway adapter.
